L4 time_since [history] {up_recent,up_mid,up_old,down_recent,down_mid,down_old,none}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), how many bars ago did OHLC last change state?
L4 route [history] {flat,up_down,down_up,straight_up,straight_down,flat_end}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), which path did OHLC take: up-then-down, down-then-up, or straight?
L4 character_change [history] {wilder,calmer,same,n_a}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), is OHLC behaving differently from its usual self?
L4 retests [history] {n_a,none,broke_down,broke_up,support_held,resistance_held}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), when price came back to a OHLC level, did the level hold?
L4 squeeze_release [history] {released_up,released_down,still_squeezed,none,n_a}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), did OHLC tighten up and then burst out, and which way?
L4 stage [history] {advance,decline,top,bottom,base,n_a}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), which trend stage is OHLC in: base, advance, top, or decline?
L4 timeframe_agreement [history] {agree_up,agree_down,disagree,flat,n_a}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), do the short-term and long-term readings of OHLC agree?
L4 shock_recovery [history] {up_shock_recovered,up_shock_partial,up_shock_holding,down_shock_recovered,down_shock_partial,down_shock_holding,none}
Over the last 20 bars of 3-day candles (~60 trading days), after a shock in OHLC, has it recovered?

L4 peak_volume [base] {is_max,50-100%,<50%,no_run}

L4 size_vs_prev [base] {up,down,flat}x{<0.5,0.5-2,>2}
Over the last 20 bars of 5-day candles (~100 trading days) for 3ATR_legs: last phase size in ATR / previous phase size in ATR? Answer one of {up,down,flat}x{<0.5,0.5-2,>2}
L4 vol_vs_prev [base] {up,down,flat}x{<0.7,0.7-1.3,>1.3}
Over the last 20 bars of 5-day candles (~100 trading days) for 3ATR_legs: last phase mean volume / previous phase mean volume? Answer one of {up,down,flat}x{<0.7,0.7-1.3,>1.3}
L4 speed_vs_prev [base] {up,down,flat}x{slower,similar,faster}
Over the last 20 bars of 5-day candles (~100 trading days) for 3ATR_legs: last phase ATR per bar / previous phase ATR per bar? Answer one of {up,down,flat}x{slower,similar,faster}
L4 pump_fade_cycles [base] pump_fade:{0,1,2,3+}x{lower_peaks,higher_peaks,mixed,n/a} | dump_recover:{0,1,2,3+}x{higher_troughs,lower_troughs,mixed,n/a}
Over the last 20 bars of 5-day candles (~100 trading days) for 3ATR_legs: separate pump-and-fade cycles in window (pump = up_run/shock_up phase >=3 ATR followed by a giveback >=50% of it before the next pump) and whether successive pump peaks are lower; mirror: dump-and-recover cycles (down_run/shock_down >=3 ATR then >=50% recovered) and whether successive troughs are higher? Answer one of pump_fade:{0,1,2,3+}x{lower_peaks,higher_peaks,mixed,n/a} | dump_recover:{0,1,2,3+}x{higher_troughs,lower_troughs,mixed,n/a}
